executable_polymarket_pnl.reason: the proxy frame has no executable Polymarket quotes, depth, fees, fills, or strict-gate outcomes required by the arbitrage backtest

pnl.warning: This is BTC-proxy strategy PnL, not executable Polymarket PnL.

embargo.rule: the preceding block ends before its forward-label window can reach the next block

sizing.calibration_scope: fitted train predictions only; frozen before all holdouts
sizing.cost_handling: forward_net_return_bps already includes the configured round-trip cost; no additional cost is deducted
sizing.overlap_rule: enter only while flat; equality at the prior exit timestamp is eligible; reset flat at each holdout boundary

policies.binary_f1: unit size when probability >= train F1-maximizing threshold
policies.confidence_weighted: clip((probability - train F1 threshold) / (1 - train F1 threshold), 0, 1)
policies.probability_proportional: size equals the predicted positive-class probability, clipped to [0, 1]
policies.top_decile: unit size when probability >= train probability q90 (higher order statistic)

sharpe.sharpe_annualized: sharpe_per_trade * sqrt((365*24*60) / position_horizon_minutes); equals the equity-curve Sharpe because equity returns are proportional to trade PnL in bps
sharpe.sharpe_per_trade: mean(trade_pnl_bps) / std(trade_pnl_bps, ddof=1); undefined (None) with fewer than two trades or zero standard deviation

sequence_model.reason: no baseline beat the majority PR-AUC and train-calibrated accuracy on every valid holdout
